_provenance.batch: 0 — harness established; terrain/population fixtures land in Batches 3-4.
_provenance.decompiler_caveat: Class and member names are obfuscated single/double letters and the decompilation is not guaranteed to be source-identical. Every value here was produced by RUNNING the decompiled classes, not by reading them.
_provenance.population_rule: Canonical deviation (plan §6.5): kj.java does NOT reseed its shared RNG before population, which would make decorations depend on chunk load order. This project reconstructs each source chunk's post-surface state from cx * 341873128712 + cz * 132897987541 plus the exact surface RNG consumption, then runs that chunk's population sequence. Fixtures that cover population record expectations under that canonicalisation.
_provenance.stub_rationale: Classes the terrain path only carries rather than reads (cy/ha/pu/dw), the population decorators Batch 3 never reaches, and nq — whose ids are re-derived from vendor nq.java on every build and refuse to drift.

terrain.layout: (x * 16 + z) * 128 + y, raw Alpha block ids
